Title: Azure Database for MySQL support for intelligent performance with MySQL 8.0 is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL support for intelligent performance with MySQL engine version 8.0 is now available. Intelligent performance includes query store, query performance insight, and performance recommendations. Use this set of features to better understand your workloads, to visually inspect them and identify bottlenecks, and to see a list of recommendations for improving the performance of your workloads.

Learn more about query store, query performance insight, and performance recommendations.
